resolutions.evidence: Page.* commands now go through cdpPageCall/cdpPageSession: Target.attachToTarget{flatten:true}, command sent with the returned sessionId and no targetId param; getPageMetrics uses Performance.enable/getMetrics/disable (Chrome serves no Page.getMetrics). Failures throw typed StealthCoreBrowserError. Proven by test/unit/domains-storage/transport.spec.ts, domains.spec.ts [fs-181][fs-182], page.spec.ts.

BrowserService.getWindowBounds resolves windowId via Browser.getWindowForTarget then sends Browser.getWindowBounds{windowId} on one connection; errors typed. Proven by domains.spec.ts [F147] and browser.spec.ts.
NetworkService cookie reads attach a page session (given or first open page); no page is TARGET_NOT_FOUND; failures reject instead of [] . Proven by domains.spec.ts [F148], network.spec.ts.

transport.ts now fetches /json/version via getRawVersion (cdpFetch + assertSameEndpoint), so a debugger URL for another host is CDP_BAD_RESPONSE before any socket opens. Proven by transport.spec.ts 'refuses a debugger URL that points at another host'.

createPageTarget and createIsolatedPageTarget dispose/close the freshly created context/target when the /json/list poll throws. Proven by targets.spec.ts 'no target, context or socket leaks when listing fails'.

The version fetch (transport, BrowserService.getVersion) and TargetService.listPageTargets share targets.ts cdpFetch/cdpJson: 5 s abort signal -> CDP_TIMEOUT, non-2xx -> CDP_BAD_RESPONSE. Proven by transport.spec.ts, browser.spec.ts, target.spec.ts.

closePageTarget, hideAllWindows, reveal and dispose close their CdpSession in finally, so a rejected Target.closeTarget or a failing listing leaves no socket open. Proven by targets.spec.ts leak tests.
